meta.description: Stage-3 unified dv/v model: station-local shallow apparent dv/v (two depth bins 0-0.3 and 0.3-3 km per station and component) + deep bound from stage-1 travel times. Below 3 km coda data only feed a nuisance; no deep field is estimated. Amplitudes are APPARENT (coupling of coda to its kernels uncertain x2.5-10): k1 = coupling 1, kprof = stage-2 profile (SC 10, LFE 5, REP 2.5).
meta.depth_verdict_rule: best one-parameter depth hypothesis beats both others by dchi2 >= 4 in k1 and kprof and under prior x0.3/x3

notes: Predictions: relative 0-3 km part only; ENV = annual part only; no dose / microseism terms; the 2024-12-20 value is tau-sensitive (network tau; see the tau x0.5 / x2 runs).
ENV_amp is a magnitude (positively biased where cos / sin are noisy).

Depth bins are exported only where both are data-constrained (posterior/prior < 0.7) and agree with the inverted-prior run; otherwise "split prior-dominated" and only the kernel-weighted 0-3 km amplitude.
Verdicts rank shallow hypotheses only; deep changes are indistinguishable from ">= 1 km"; the deep crust is bounded by stage 1 only. Repeaters reuse the LFE kernel fractions.
LFE coda from unregularised monthly bins (data/sci/decline/monthly_bins.csv); the regularised pool_clean curves are only a variant.

Annual (ENV) signal at >= 1 km at BK.BLAS, BK.RVIT disappears without the 0.1-0.6 Hz SC bands and LP: it likely reflects seasonal noise-source (microseism) changes in the low bands, not a deep hydrological signal.
Annual (ENV) >= 1 km verdict survives without the low bands at BK.GHOP, NC.KMPB (microseism-power regressor already in step 1); treat with caution.
